## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. Turn-loop call sites: a real run sequences
   `assemble`/`retrieve`/`compact`/`mark_scope_ended` so
   `context.compaction.*`/`context.procedure.selected`/
   `context.artefact.*`/`context.retrieval.completed`/
   `artefact.delivered` mint durable rows from the loop, not only unit
   calls.
2. `resume_set` consumers — the projected-resume path reads the set.
3. Judged/human detectors (member e) + the OOP differential conformance
   corpus run (member f) over `benchset.stage3.v1`.
4. DF-S1.19-2's corpus legs as recorded-`model_io` batteries.
5. DF-S2.8-1 (minus steer), DF-S1.19-1, DF-S1.19-2 discharged or reduced
   to dated residuals.

## Acceptance criteria (ticket verbatim)

- [ ] a real run's ledger shows the context producer sequence
  (`assembled` → `retrieval.completed` → `compaction.*` → `scope_ended`)
  minted by the driver (deterministic · fixture-verified)
- [ ] `resume_set` consumers read the set on resume; a
  `resume_set`-armed run resumes with the right members (deterministic)
- [ ] judged/human detector legs + OOP differential corpus run over
  `benchset.stage3.v1` (or typed `n/a` row) (agentic · fixture-verified)
- [ ] DF-S2.8-1, DF-S1.19-1, DF-S1.19-2 carry dated progress/DONE lines
  (agentic)
- [ ] universal phase-gate AC (agentic)

Requirement ids: `DF-S2.8-1`, `DF-S1.19-1`, `DF-S1.19-2`, `BL-15`;
`R-2.4.1`, `R-2.4.2`, `R-2.4.3`, `R-2.4.4`, `R-2.4.5`.

  batches park `wait`, quarantine ordered before `lifecycle.turn.
  finished`, `security.audit.checkpoint` audit members declared
  (`hh-ledger/src/classes.rs`). ADR-0336 D2.

- Phase 5 verification (2026-10-06): `cargo test --workspace` —

## AC evidence (2026-10-06)

- **AC-1 producer sequence (fixture-verified):**
  `hh-control/tests/r2_5.rs::producer_sequence_lands_durable_and_ordered`
  — a real driver run's durable order: `context.assembled` →
  `context.retrieval.completed` → `context.memory.read` →
  `context.compaction.started` → `context.compaction.completed` →
  `context.memory.invalidated{fired_stamp: scope_ended}`; all rows
  driver-appended. `hh-embed/tests/r2_5.rs` runs the same legs over a
  real `EmbedService` drive (`context.procedure.selected` before
  `context.assembled`, delivered → activated → followed).
- **AC-2 `resume_set`:** `resume_set_drains_before_first_decide` (armed
  heads consumed before the first `decide`; the `context.memory.read`
  rows record delivered members), `resume_set_without_port_refuses`
  (typed `UnbackedPort{resume_set}`), embed resume-fold rehydration.
- **AC-3 detectors + OOP corpus:** driver-level judged/human legs
  (`judged_verify_mints_*`, `human_artefact_mark_mints_activated`);
  `r2_5_differential.rs` — 23/23 members byte-identical evicted-seq
  verdicts vs the kernel rung; corpus legs emit typed `n/a` rows per
  member where a leg cannot run hermetically (46 rows).
- **AC-4 DF dispositions:** DF-S2.8-1 / DF-S1.19-1 / DF-S1.19-2 carry
  dated 2026-10-06 (R2.5) progress lines; residuals named.
- **AC-5 universal gate:** fmt/clippy/workspace-test/drift/removability/
  build-memory green (numbers above); requirement ids stamped in
  `pr/R2.5.md`; ADR-0336; BUILD_INDEX row + LEDGER advanced; layer:
  fixture-verified throughout; no merges (OPERATOR).
